daily-image.title: Image of the day
daily-image.body: Bing's photo of the day can now fill the reading pane when no message is open.

save-message.title: Save a message as a file
save-message.body: Save… in a message’s menu downloads it as EML, readable by every mail client, or as MSG for Outlook.

sender-avatars.title: Sender avatars
sender-avatars.body: The message list can now show each sender’s picture, or their initials, next to the message. Turn it on in Settings > Mail.
